text:
ops-bot: Urgent notice 20: we've flagged elevated thermal throttling on a subset of Dedicated A100Z racks in ap-southeast-2 (sydney-syd-1). New reservations into the affected pods are paused immediately.

sophie.prod: FYI this affects about 14 racks; impact mostly on long-context workloads. We're switching affected hosts to the cooled A100Zv2 replacement pool over the next 36h. No planned customer-facing downtime for reserved workloads; we'll migrate capacity transparently where possible.

rahul-sre: Infra summary: thermal sensors tripped on racks 7-20. Root cause appears to be a firmware regression in fan curve handling after last firmware bundle. Mitigation: were rolling the fan-curve hotfix and concurrently evacuating VMs off hot racks to A100Zv2 nodes. Live-migration scripts are running now. Gate: migration will stop if nvlink error rate >0.2% or if live-migrate fails on >2% of jobs.

exec-bench: Bench note: A100Zv2 shows similar p50 and slightly better p95 on long sequences; token cost roughly equal. We'll publish quick perf delta in #eng-runtime in ~2h.

emily-sales: Sales ask: what do we tell customers in sydney with pending reservations? Any temporary credits or migration assistance?

sophie.prod: Policy: automatic migrations for active Reserved customers. New reservations into the impacted pods are paused for 14 days while we finish replacements. For high-priority enterprise accounts, open a capacity request with the tag "syd-a100z-urgent" and we'll prioritize. We are offering one week of credit for any customer who experiences degraded p95 during the migration window.

tony-support: Support playbook: if customers report increased latency, collect model id, route, seq len, sample tokens, and whether they saw 429/5xx. Escalate to #eng-sre with subject "syd-a100z". I'll update canned replies.

rahul-sre: Timeline: 0-12h: live-migrate critical jobs off affected racks, push fan-curve hotfix; 12-36h: replace with A100Zv2 and validate nvlink/thermal metrics; 36-72h: monitor and open reservations progressively. If any health gate fails well rollback migrations and schedule a deeper maintenance.

ops-bot: If you need a reservation exception or to flag a strategic account, use the capacity request form and add "syd-a100z-urgent". Reactions: :ambulance: :australia:
